podcast.body: Bon Jovi's debut single, released in April 1984, became a number 39 hit. The song was notable for sounding "the least like a Bon Jovi song" and featured John Bon Jovi fronting journeyman session musicians he never played with again. It was considered "emblematic of glam metal in 1984," a genre then recognized simply as metal before the "hair metal" term emerged years later. "Their debut single, a number 39 hit in April 1984, is a really good song. Maybe because it sounds the least like a Bon Jovi song."
